basics.name: Jhon Vargas Jaramillo
basics.label: Full-Stack & AI Engineer  |  Energy Systems & Electrification
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building full-stack applications, AI-driven agents, and simulation platforms for the energy transition. Background in aerospace and vehicle electrification with hands-on experience in embedded control systems and dynamic modeling. Currently architecting web platforms, automation workflows, and optimization engines for EV fleet operations at a US-based company. Founded and maintain a multi-tenant SaaS product serving 60+ active users. Strong track record of translating complex domain problems into production software using Python, Django, React, and TypeScript.

work.name: LOGIOS Global
highlights: Architected AI agent pipelines leveraging LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation to automate fleet financial report synthesis from multi-source vehicle telemetry, reducing analyst preparation time by ~70%

Engineered a full-stack electrification analysis platform (React/TypeScript + Django/PostgreSQL) with interactive scenario modeling, enabling clients to evaluate fleet transition strategies across 50+ vehicle configurations
Developed dynamic EV simulation models and a charge scheduling optimization engine using PSO and MILP, reducing estimated fleet energy costs by 15–25% through tariff-aware charging windows
Built real-time fleet telemetry system using MQTT protocol with WebSocket-fed React dashboards for live visualization of 12–15 bus fleets processing 1,000+ data points per minute
Created integrated systems for operational cost estimation incorporating energy storage degradation modeling, supporting investment decisions for renewable energy infrastructure

Designed and deployed n8n-based automation workflows orchestrating AI agents to respond to MQTT-driven transport events in real time, reducing manual incident triage and enabling autonomous operational decision-making

work.name: EAFIT / Universidad Nacional
highlights: Invented and implemented real-time embedded control software for a novel motorcycle hybridization kit, including an MPC-based energy management system currently in patent application process

Conducted dynamometer bench testing and on-road validation of simulation models, confirming real-world performance aligned with predicted autonomy improvements
